tagline: Phone and PC on the same Wi-Fi — scan the QR code to transfer
chk_discovery: Visible on the LAN (UDP broadcast discovery)
qr_placeholder: The QR code appears after the service starts
pub_hint: Use “Add files” for files and “Add folder” for whole directories; any format is supported
recv_hint: Files uploaded from the phone are saved here
bind_lan_only: Listening on the LAN IP only: {ip}
port_fallback: Port note: default port {requested} is in use, switched to {port}
choose_folder_title: Select a folder to publish (the whole directory)
select_first: Select a file in the publish list first
bg_formats: JPG / PNG / WebP / BMP supported. The image stays on this PC and is never uploaded.
bg_dim_tip: Higher values dim the background more and keep text readable; 0% shows the original image.
bg_saved_tip: Saved in settings.json and applied again on the next launch.
opacity_tip: Card fill blends the card color with the average background color sampled under the card at this strength. Tk widgets have no real alpha — this simulates translucency.
lang_note: Restart required: Tkinter fixes widget text at creation, and rebuilding the UI live would drop the running server state.
lang_restart_msg: Language saved. It takes effect after a restart. Restart now?
spaces_hint: A folder decides where phone uploads land. Deleting a folder only removes the entry; files on disk are kept.
spaces_fallback: Config is broken; using temporary inbox / shared folders. Saving any change rewrites the config.
space_confirm_delete:
Delete folder "{name}"?
Only the entry is removed; files on disk are kept.
space_delete_ok: Folder "{name}" removed; files on disk are kept.
space_last: At least one folder must remain.
space_no_path: Please choose or enter a folder path.
space_pick_default: The default folder cannot be deleted; set another folder as default first.
space_ro_hint: Read-only folder: upload and delete are disabled.
space_manage_hint: Manage folders on the desktop app.
